title: Strong evidence: backend projects with genuine metrics
provenance: Written for this evaluation. Not copied from any real job posting or resume.
job_description:
Backend Engineer (Python) - Internal Platforms

We are hiring a backend engineer to build and maintain internal REST services used by about 40 teams. You will design endpoints with FastAPI, model data in PostgreSQL, write automated tests and ship every service as a Docker container.

Responsibilities:
- Design, build and document REST APIs.
- Write unit and integration tests with pytest.
- Investigate production issues and improve service reliability; our services target 99.9% uptime.
- Review code and share knowledge with the team.

Requirements:
- Solid Python and either FastAPI or Flask.
- SQL and PostgreSQL.
- Docker and Git.
- Experience with automated testing.

Nice to have: Redis for caching and GitHub Actions for continuous delivery.
